title: AI Employment Verification | Superunit
excerpt: AI employment verification by agents that call, email, and fax employers directly. Verifications no database can finish, completed in under 24 hours and at up to 80% lower cost than staffing.
content_html:
Y Combinator S24

[ Employment ]
verifications
straight from the source

Our AI agents call HR, payroll, and managers — and back it up over email and fax — to confirm the facts a database returns as “not found.”

200,000+

Verifications completed

< 24 hours

Median turnaround time

70%+

Employment verification completion rate

Up to 80%

Cost reduction vs. traditional staffing

Trusted across hiring, lending, and leasing

Scale verifications without scaling your team.

AI agents research contacts, call HR, send emails and faxes, follow up, and collect documents — autonomously and around the clock. Every result ships with a full FCRA-compliant audit trail.

24/7 outreach

Phone, email, fax in parallel

Multiple languages

Recordings & transcripts on every call

Scales without hiring

The Difference

Built for the verifications no one else can finish.

Everything your team used to chase by hand — handled autonomously, end to end.

Automate Painful Verifications

AI agents handle the calls, emails, and faxes your team dreads. Fully automated, always on, no follow-up required.

Bypass the Roadblocks

When databases return "not found," we go directly to the employer. No dead ends — just verified results.

Faster Than Humanly Possible

Phone, email, and fax fire simultaneously the moment an order is submitted. What takes your team days takes us hours.

Pristine Documentation

Every call recorded, transcribed, and logged. Full audit trail on every verification — FCRA compliant from day one.

Pay for results, not attempts.
